newsitem.title: KENYA: Prices seen mixed at Kenyan tea auction.
newsitem.headline: Prices seen mixed at Kenyan tea auction.

text.p: Tea prices varied at Kenya's weekly export auction in Mombasa on good general demand which eased as the sale progressed, traders said.
Brighter BP1s were irregularly lower by 4-8 U.S. cents while mediums opened firm but were barely steady by the close. Lower mediums and plainer sorts were firm to dearer by two cents.
Brighter PDUSTs were firm to five cents higher with coloury mediums advancing by up to three cents.
Fannings and Dusts remained a strong feature but the fibrous descriptions generally eased.
Pakistan and Egypt were the main buyers.
